awesome-geelark-skill v1.0.1

- Added six new utility scripts: create_phone_profile.py, doctor.py, error_codes.py, handle_android_permissions.py, install_app.py, and ui_smoke_test.py.
- Introduced a comprehensive “Doctor” diagnostic script to check environment, dependencies, network, and API connectivity.
- Added a command-line installer for searching and installing apps directly to cloud phones.

- Detailed new safety, credential, and RPA guidance for secure operation.
